citations.claim: NS green immediately before violating yellow (phase NS green)
NS turns yellow - start of truncated yellow
NS still yellow after 4th second of yellow
first violating step: NS already red, yellow lasted only 4s vs required 6s

counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event (events [] vs [{t:31 emergency N duration 1}]) - one field change, same 108 steps. Without preemption the yellow timer stays synchronized and NS yellow lasts full 6s, so yellow_duration no longer violated.

explanation: Shrunk 1s emergency at t=31 on N preempts EW green (EW yellow forced at step 31) and shortens subsequent cycle. The controller's yellow countdown is not properly reset after the emergency preemption, so the later NS yellow that starts at step 104 is truncated to 4s (steps 104-107 yellow, step 108 already all-red) instead of required 6s, violating yellow_duration on approaches 0 and 2. Removing the emergency eliminates the desync and restores full 6s yellow.
vision_note: Steps 105-107 show yellow on two opposite approaches (north/south) while the crossing approaches remain red. Step 108 abruptly shows all four approaches on red, so the yellow was displayed for only ~4 seconds before switching to all-red.
